 * The CLI/web entrypoint lives in `./cli.js` (published as the `leakshield`
 * bin) so importing this module never starts an interactive process.
 */

# leakshield > 🌐 English | [繁體中文](./README.zh-TW.md) **A gatekeeper that scans for sensitive content before you feed code, documents, or data to AI services.** Four supported modes: - **OpenCode Plugin**: The enforced ingress gate for OpenCode. Use this when OpenCode sends content to a model. - **pi adapter**: An in-process pi extension that guards the agent's provider requests through the shared wire core. - **CLI**: Manual or CI scanning of text, files, and directories; supports redaction. - **Web UI**: Local browser interface and REST endpoint for manual scanning. MCP server mode has been removed. It depended on the model voluntarily calling a scan tool after it had already received the relevant context, so it cannot provide the plugin's security boundary. | Mode | Start it with | Use it for | |------|---------------|------------| | OpenCode Plugin | Add the `leakshield` package or the `dist` directory to `opencode.json` (OpenCode v2) | Automatic, fail-closed protection for OpenCode model inputs and tool outputs | | pi adapter | `pi install /absolute/path/to/built/leakshield` (next npm release: `pi install npm:leakshield`; [setup](docs/pi.md)) | Masked pi provider requests and restored read/write/edit/bash arguments | | CLI | `npm run scan -- --file ./path` (or `leakshield --file ./path` after a global install / `npm link`) | Explicit local or CI scans; it never sends content to a model | | Web UI | `npm run web` | Manual browser scans at `http://localhost:3000` | ## Project status **Experimental, `0.x`.** Published to npm as `leakshield`: run `npx leakshield --help` to see the commands, or build locally (`npm ci && npm run build`) and point OpenCode at the `dist` directory. Without arguments or input, the CLI waits on stdin. - Transparent mode has been verified on OpenCode v2.0.28 with local loopback providers, and once against a real OpenAI model. The 0.3.0 tool restoration was rechecked on OpenCode v2.2.5 with a loopback provider, the OpenChamber render tool and `rtk` ([record](docs/evidence/2026-11-06-opencode-2.2.5-tool-restoration.md)). It is **not** a guarantee that nothing sensitive reaches a model: the recommended hook-first setup is reported as `PARTIAL` by `--doctor`, and content added after the plugin's hooks or sent by permitted tools (curl, remote MCP) is outside its coverage. - Claude Code is supported through a local proxy (`leakshield --claude-code-proxy`, then `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`), verified with Claude Code 2.1.321 against a loopback stub upstream ([record](docs/evidence/2026-11-21-claude-code-proxy.md)). It masks model requests and restores assistant text, but does not restore placeholders at tool execution yet: see [Claude Code](docs/claude-code.md). - pi is supported through an in-process extension that wraps the agent's `fetch`, masks the three wire APIs it supports, and restores read/write/edit/bash arguments locally. Verified against pi 1.6.0 with a recording stub upstream ([record](docs/evidence/2026-11-23-pi-extension.md)); providers whose transport bypasses fetch (Codex WebSocket, Bedrock) are refused, and OAuth-only accounts are not supported. See [pi adapter](docs/pi.md). - Not yet verified: OS-keychain custody on Windows and Linux (macOS verified 2026-10-20), a real Anthropic provider, long histories on other providers, long-running use ([#26](https://github.com/jwcrystal/leakshield/issues/26)). - Defaults may still change during `0.x`; see the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). - Verification records: [docs/evidence](docs/evidence/README.md). Report vulnerabilities privately: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). License: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). --- ## Quickstart Needs OpenCode v2 and Node.js 20 or later. 1. Install: ```bash npm install -g leakshield ``` 2. Register the plugin in your project's `opencode.json`. With no options, `mode` defaults to `transparent`: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [{ "package": "leakshield" }] } ``` 3. Check the install. Exit code 0 means `PROTECTED` or `PARTIAL`; see [what `PARTIAL` means](#what-partial-means). This check cannot see inside a live session, so run step 4 as well. ```bash leakshield --doctor ``` 4. Run the smoke test. It uses a temporary directory and a synthetic value, not a real credential: ```bash SMOKE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" cat > "$SMOKE_DIR/opencode.json" <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [{ "package": "leakshield", "options": { "mode": "block" } }] } EOF (cd "$SMOKE_DIR" && opencode run --standalone \ "Smoke test only. Do not reveal or use this token: sk-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA") rm -rf "$SMOKE_DIR" ``` The model-facing message must contain the LeakShield block notice and must not contain the synthetic token. Do not use a real credential for this test. Before relying on it, read [what this protects — and what it does not](#what-this-protects--and-what-it-does-not). For source builds and other options, see [Installation](#installation) and [OpenCode Plugin](#opencode-plugin-recommended). New contributors: [3-minute onboarding](docs/ONBOARDING.zh-TW.md) (Traditional Chinese only). --- ## Detection Coverage | Type | Description | Severity | |------|-------------|----------| | API Key | OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS, Stripe (live keys) | 🔴 HIGH | | Secret / Password | Generic password assignments, AWS Secret | 🔴 HIGH | | Token | GitHub, Slack, Hugging Face, JWT, Bearer Token | 🔴 HIGH | | Private Key | PEM private key blocks | 🔴 HIGH | | DB Connection String | MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ADO format, etc. | 🔴 HIGH | | Taiwan National ID | Format validation | 🔴 HIGH | | Credit Card Number | 13–19 digits, Luhn checksum required | 🔴 HIGH | | IBAN | Compact or 4-char groups, mod-97 checksum required | 🔴 HIGH | | Public IPv4 Address | Private/loopback/CGNAT/reserved ranges excluded; runs longer than four groups are reported whole | 🟡 MEDIUM | | Private IPv4 / VPN CIDR | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["private-ipv4"]: true`); networks from `settings.private_cidrs`, default RFC 1918 + CGNAT + link-local | 🟡 MEDIUM | | Email Address | All email formats | 🟡 MEDIUM | | URL Embedded Credential | `scheme://user:password@host` — only the userinfo span is masked | 🔴 HIGH | | Taiwan Mobile Number | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["phone-tw"]: true`); digit runs are a measured false-positive source | 🟡 MEDIUM | | International Phone | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["phone-intl"]: true`); same trade-off as above | 🟢 LOW | | HTTP(S) URL | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides.url: true`) | 🟢 LOW | | NDA Keywords | Custom (see `config/guard.config.yaml`) | 🔴 HIGH | | Private Domains | Custom (see `config/guard.config.yaml`) | 🟡 MEDIUM | > **Detection boundaries** (per `src/rules/builtin.ts`): the generic secret rule matches only the keywords `password`, `passwd`, `secret`, `private_key`, `client_secret` with a value of **8+ characters** — generic `api_key=`/`token=` assignments are not matched unless the value itself matches a vendor pattern. It also skips an unquoted value that is a code expression, such as `process.env.DB_PASSWORD` or `z.string().min(6)`; a call whose arguments hold another string literal is still reported. Credit card and IBAN matches require a valid checksum, and the credit card rule skips a run of one repeated digit and digits inside a UUID. The URL credential and DB connection rules skip a password that is a `${…}`, `{{…}}` or `<…>` placeholder. IP matches cover only public/routable IPv4, and a dotted run longer than four groups is reported whole so an address embedded in it is masked instead of left behind (dotted dates such as `2026.10.21.14.32.59` therefore report as an IP run too). Not covered by any rule: street/postal addresses, dates, IPv6, and values below the 8-character minimum for generic secret assignments. SSH remote authorities (`user@host:path`, `ssh://user@host/…`) are not reported as email; private domains and path keywords still apply inside them, and the password half of `scheme://user:password@host` is reported as a URL credential instead. Private IPv4 is opt-in because the literal also matches version numbers and timestamps; `settings.private_cidrs` narrows it to the organisation's own ranges, and an entry that does not parse fails the config load. Every built-in rule has a stable id and can be toggled via `settings.rule_overrides` in `config/guard.config.yaml` (unknown ids fail config load); the URL rule ships disabled because always-on URL masking would flag provider endpoints. The same rule set (built-in + `config/guard.config.yaml`) applies to every mode — `block`, `redact`, and `transparent`. --- ## Decision Model Every scan produces a **decision** that tells the caller how to handle the content: | Decision | When | Risk Level | Meaning | |----------|------|-----------|---------| | `ALLOW` | No findings | LOW | Content is clean — safe to send | | `WARN` | LOW-severity findings only | MEDIUM | Minor items detected — reminder shown, content can be sent | | `CONFIRM` | MEDIUM or HIGH findings | HIGH / CRITICAL | Sensitive content detected — user must explicitly confirm | ### CONFIRM Handling When the decision is `CONFIRM`, the CLI is non-interactive: it prints a warning card and a next-step hint, and does not prompt you to choose. The hint points to `--format json` (read `redactedContent`) or `--redact` (sanitized output). Exit code `1` means the content was blocked. The `CONFIRM` decision includes: - `recommendedAction`: `REVIEW` (MEDIUM findings) or `BLOCK` (HIGH findings) - `safePreview`: a masked excerpt around the first finding - `redactedContent`: the full content with all sensitive spans replaced `safePreview` and `redactedContent` are left out when a sensitive span cannot be located exactly, such as an encoded run split by a zero-width character. A missing field means no safe version is available. ### JSON Output Fields When using `--format json`, the output includes these decision-oriented fields: | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | `decision` | `ALLOW`, `WARN`, or `CONFIRM` | | `riskLevel` | `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, or `CRITICAL` | | `recommendedAction` | `REVIEW` or `BLOCK` (CONFIRM only) | | `findings` | Array of sanitized findings (no internal metadata) | | `safePreview` | Masked excerpt (CONFIRM only; can be absent) | | `redactedContent` | Full redacted text (CONFIRM only; can be absent) | --- ## Installation Requires Node.js 20 or later. Mapping persistence needs 22.13 or later. ```bash npm install -g leakshield leakshield --help ``` `npx leakshield …` runs the published package without installing it. The npm package ships only the compiled code, so it has no `config/` directory; see [Configuration](#configuration) to add one. To build from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/jwcrystal/leakshield.git cd leakshield npm install npm run build ``` For local development, install the build globally or `npm link` it, then use `leakshield` directly. `npm run scan -- ...` works from this repository without installing. ### npm Scripts | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `npm run build` | Clean, then compile TypeScript → `dist/` | | `npm run clean` | Remove `dist/` | | `npm start` | Run the built CLI (`node dist/cli.js --cli`) | | `npm run dev` | CLI mode (no build needed) | | `npm run scan` | CLI scan (no build needed) | | `npm run web` | Start the local Web UI (no build needed) | | `npm test` | Run unit tests | | `npm run test:watch` | Run tests in watch mode | | `npm run binary` | Build standalone binary for current platform (macOS ARM) | | `npm run binary:win` | Cross-compile for Windows x64 | | `npm run binary:linux` | Cross-compile for Linux x64 | | `npm run binary:mac-intel` | Cross-compile for macOS Intel | | `npm run binary:win-icon` | Build the Windows binary with the app icon (`scripts/build-win.js`) | | `npm run binary:all` | Build all platforms at once | | `npm run bundle:mac` | Build the binary and package a macOS bundle (`scripts/bundle-mac.sh`) | --- ## Standalone Binary Can't use Node.js or npm? Build a standalone binary with [Bun](https://bun.sh) — no runtime needed on the target machine. ```bash # One-command build for current platform npm run binary # Cross-compile for other platforms npm run binary:win # Windows x64 → leakshield.exe npm run binary:linux # Linux x64 → leakshield-linux npm run binary:all # All platforms ``` Or directly with Bun: ```bash bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=leakshield.exe ``` The output is a single executable — hand it to anyone, no dependencies required. ### Configuration for binary and npm users The binary and the npm package work out of the box with built-in defaults. To customize rules (NDA keywords, private domains, custom regex patterns), place a config file in one of these locations: | Location | Scope | |----------|-------| | `./config/guard.config.yaml` | Current working directory | | `~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml` | All sessions (user home) | ```bash # Quick start: copy config/guard.config.example.yaml from this repository, # then replace its sample keywords and domains mkdir -p ~/.leakshield cp config/guard.config.example.yaml ~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml # Or per-project mkdir -p ./config # Create/edit ./config/guard.config.yaml as needed ``` See [Configuration](#configuration) section for available options. --- ## Usage ### OpenCode Plugin (recommended) When loaded successfully, the OpenCode plugin is the enforced integration. It scans and blocks user text before OpenCode persists or sends it to a model, sanitizes system prompts and tool definitions, protects tool output before the next model turn, and re-scans history before replay. It always enables encoded-content detection. Invalid plugin options or scanner configuration make every protected hook fail closed and abort the model request. A bounded SHA-256 decision cache avoids repeatedly scanning unchanged history without retaining original or redacted content. Transparent mode details: [Encoded content and tool schemas](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md#encoded-content-and-tool-schemas). LeakShield supports OpenCode v2 only. v2 hosts load the package `id` + `setup(ctx)` definition. OpenCode v1 is no longer supported: a v1 host that loads the package gets hooks that fail closed and abort every model request, and `leakshield --doctor` reports `BROKEN`. Upgrade to OpenCode v2. **OpenCode v2** — point `plugins` at the published package, or at the `dist` directory of a local build: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ { "package": "leakshield" // or "/absolute/path/to/leakshield/dist" // No options: mode defaults to "transparent" on v2. // Add "options": { "mode": "block" } to refuse instead of pseudonymize. } ] } ``` Note that v2 only accepts plugin *directories* (it resolves `dist/index.js`) or package names; a `file://` URL to a single `.js` file is rejected with `configured plugin path must be a directory`. The default `mode` is **`transparent`** (see [Transparent mode](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md)). `block` replaces unsafe content with a disclosure-free notice; set `"mode": "block"` to use it. Set `mode` to `redact` only when you explicitly want recognized direct matches replaced with `[REDACTED_TYPE]` placeholders. `--doctor` shows the mode in effect and marks it `(default)` when the options omit it. #### What `PARTIAL` means `leakshield --doctor` exits 0 for two statuses. They are install-level results, not a guarantee that nothing sensitive reaches a model. Pass `--doctor opencode`, `--doctor claude-code` or `--doctor pi` (also `--doctor=`) to check one host with its own exit code. | Status | Setup | Meaning | |--------|-------|---------| | `PROTECTED` | `block` or `redact`, or transparent with `wireProtection` omitted or `true` (the v2 default), and every de …[文件过长——中段 8KB 抽样]… P body or supported WS frame is validated too | | `PARTIAL` | Transparent with `wireProtection: false` ([hook-first example](config/opencode.hook-first.example.json)), or a host whose [declared capability rows](docs/host-capabilities.md) include `unknown` or `outside` | Final outbound HTTP bodies are not inspected, or a declared egress is not covered; the doctor names the row and the issue that closes it | Doctor prints `Configuration status` and `Wire protection` separately from host-wide `Coverage`. `Wire protection: enabled` describes the validated configuration, not proof of interception in a live session; block mode reports `not-applicable`, and an unknown configuration reports `unknown`. A `PARTIAL` verdict lists configuration and host-coverage reasons separately, including both when both apply. Host coverage is not filtered to your selected provider/model. Each host section also prints its declared credential handling, mapping-persistence policy and complete residual list; `opt-in` describes persistence support, not whether it is enabled in your install. With `PARTIAL`: - Later-added content or attachments may leave unmasked, even with `attachments: "block"`. - **Content-hook masking failures still refuse the affected call**; hook-only does not silently forward unprotectable raw content. See [Wire protection](docs/plugin/wire-protection.md) for both levels. #### Detailed guides - [Transparent mode](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md): placeholders, supported protocols, tool argument restoration (per field, `code`/`script` fields, Code Mode, `curl`, `rtk`), restart limitation - [Wire protection](docs/plugin/wire-protection.md): hook-only and final wire levels, AI SDK providers, refusals, reply-side recovery - [Native WebSocket](docs/plugin/websocket.md): experimental Responses-family support and its limits - [Mapping persistence](docs/plugin/persistence.md): opt-in encrypted storage, key custody, erasure - [Capacity and lifecycle](docs/plugin/capacity.md): budgets, session limits, retention - [Readonly env queries](docs/plugin/env-queries.md): opt-in tools that answer configuration questions without returning values - [Host capability matrix](docs/host-capabilities.md): per-host declaration of which model egress and surfaces are protected, refused, absent, or outside interception, and the invariants a new adapter must satisfy #### Persistence risk notes (read before enabling) Mapping persistence is opt-in; see [Mapping persistence](docs/plugin/persistence.md). - The design is dual-secret — the DB file alone or the key alone exposes nothing; both together do. - Backups (Time Machine, cloud sync) copy `SGP.db`: `forget` cannot reclaim what a backup already captured, and a restored backup plus a surviving key can re-identify old sessions — treat backup retention accordingly. - The keychain defends offline file theft (stolen disk, stolen backups, a copied `SGP.db`); it does not defend malware already running inside your login session. - The keyfile option lowers the bar to "both files from the same directory tree" and is intended for headless/server environments without a keychain service. **OpenCode v2 only — email de-identification trial:** the opt-in `deidentify` option (valid only together with `mode: "redact"`) additionally replaces repeated MEDIUM email findings with stable, opaque `[SG-EMAIL-…]` placeholders so an agent can correlate records without seeing the addresses. The mapping key is generated once per plugin setup (one OpenCode session), held in memory only, and never persisted — placeholders are stable within a live session but change after a restart, and no reverse mapping exists. Everything else keeps its existing disposition: HIGH credentials are still redacted/blocked, and truncated, encoded, or unverifiable content blocks the whole unit. ```jsonc { "package": "/absolute/path/to/leakshield/dist", "options": { "mode": "redact", "deidentify": true } } ``` Attachments: transparent mode supports an `attachments` policy (plural; `attachment` is not recognized). **`"block"` (default)** omits media/file parts at content hooks and replaces them with a notice; the model cannot read those omitted images. Final wire protection also refuses residual wire attachment parts; hook-first does not inspect late-added attachments. **`"allow"`** sends attachments through unscanned and appends a visible notice part — an explicit decision that you vouch for their content (`"allow"` requires `mode: "transparent"`). In block/redact modes attachments are blocked as before. Existing conversations can replay originals, subject to the [restart limitations](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md#restart-limitation); starting a new conversation is not a substitute for verifying recovery. The plugin protects OpenCode model requests only, not other AI clients or local tools. OpenCode currently logs and skips modules that fail before their plugin factory can run, such as a missing package or JavaScript syntax error. 每次掃描都會產生一個**決策**，告訴呼叫端該如何處理內容： | 決策 | 時機 | 風險等級 | 意義 | |------|------|----------|------| | `ALLOW` | 沒有發現 | LOW | 內容乾淨，可安全送出 | | `WARN` | 只有 LOW 嚴重度的發現 | MEDIUM | 偵測到次要項目，顯示提醒，內容仍可送出 | | `CONFIRM` | 有 MEDIUM 或 HIGH 的發現 | HIGH / CRITICAL | 偵測到敏感內容，使用者必須明確確認 | ### CONFIRM 的處理方式 決策為 `CONFIRM` 時，CLI 是非互動式的：會印出警告卡片與下一步提示，不會請你選擇。提示會建議使用 `--format json`（讀取 `redactedContent`）或 `--redact`（輸出脫敏版本）。Exit code `1` 表示內容已被攔截。 `CONFIRM` 決策包含： - `recommendedAction`：`REVIEW`（MEDIUM 發現）或 `BLOCK`（HIGH 發現） - `safePreview`：圍繞第一個發現的遮罩摘錄 - `redactedContent`：所有敏感片段都已取代的完整內容 無法精確定位敏感片段時（例如編碼片段中夾了零寬字元），不會有 `safePreview` 和 `redactedContent`。欄位不存在代表沒有可用的安全版本。 ### JSON 輸出欄位 使用 `--format json` 時，輸出包含以下與決策相關的欄位： | 欄位 | 說明 | |------|------| | `decision` | `ALLOW`、`WARN` 或 `CONFIRM` | | `riskLevel` | `LOW`、`MEDIUM`、`HIGH` 或 `CRITICAL` | | `recommendedAction` | `REVIEW` 或 `BLOCK`（僅 CONFIRM） | | `findings` | 已清理的發現陣列（不含內部中繼資料） | | `safePreview` | 遮罩摘錄（僅 CONFIRM；可能不存在） | | `redactedContent` | 完整的脫敏文字（僅 CONFIRM；可能不存在） | --- 套件都可直接使用內建預設值。若要自訂規則（NDA 關鍵字、私有網域、自訂正則），將設定檔放在以下任一位置： | 位置 | 範圍 | |------|------| | `./config/guard.config.yaml` | 當前工作目錄 | | `~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml` | 所有位置（家目錄） | ```bash # 快速開始：從此 ./config/guard.config.yaml ``` 詳見[設定](#設定檔)章節。 --- ## 使用方式 ### OpenCode Plugin（建議使用） OpenCode plugin 成功載入後會成為強制性整合：它會在 OpenCode 儲存或送出使用者文字給模型前掃描並攔截，清理 system prompt 與 tool definition，並在下一輪模型讀取前清理工具輸出及歷史訊息。它會固定啟用編碼內容偵測。plugin 選項或掃描設定無效時，所有受保護 hook 都會 fail closed 並中止模型請求。受限的 SHA-256 決策快取會避免重複掃描未變動歷史，同時不保留原文或脫敏後內容。 Transparent 模式細節見[編碼內容與 tool schema](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md#編碼內容與-tool-schema)。 LeakShield 只支援 OpenCode v2：v2 載入套件的 `id` + `setup(ctx)` 定義。OpenCode v1 已不再支援：v1 host 載入此套件時會得到 fail-closed 的 hooks，中止每一個模型請求，`leakshield --doctor` 也會回報 `BROKEN`。請升級到 OpenCode v2。 **OpenCode v2** — 將 `plugins` 指向已發佈的套件，或本機 build 的 `dist` 目錄： ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ { "package": "leakshield" // 或 "/絕對路徑/leakshield/dist" // 不設定 options 時，v2 的 mode 預設為 "transparent"。 // 想改成直接攔截，加上 "options": { "mode": "block" }。 } ] } ``` 注意 v2 只接受 plugin「目錄」（會解析 `dist/index.js`）或套件名稱；指向單一 `.js` 檔的 `file://` URL 會被拒絕，並出現 `configured plugin path must be a directory`。 `mode` 的預設值是 **`transparent`**（見 [Transparent 模式](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md)）。`block` 會用不含機敏值的攔截訊息替換危險內容；想使用這個行為，請設定 `"mode": "block"`。只有在你明確希望已辨識的直接命中改為 `[REDACTED_TYPE]` 佔位符時，才設定 `mode: "redact"`。`--doctor` 會顯示實際生效的 mode，沒有設定時會標示 `(default)`。 #### `PARTIAL` 的意思 `leakshield --doctor` 在兩種狀態下 exit 0。它們是安裝層的結果，不保證敏感內容絕不會送到模型。可用 `--doctor opencode`、`--doctor claude-code` 或 `--doctor pi`（也支援 `--doctor=`）只檢查單一 host，exit code 只反映它。 | 模式](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md): 佔位符、支援的協定、工具參數還原（依欄位判斷、`code`／`script` 欄位、Code Mode、`curl`、`rtk`）、重啟限制 - [Wire 保護](docs/plugin/wire-protection.zh-TW.md): hook-only 與 final wire 兩種層級、AI SDK provider、拒絕、回覆端復原 - [Native WebSocket](docs/plugin/websocket.zh-TW.md): 實驗性的 Responses-family 支援與限制 - [映射持久化](docs/plugin/persistence.zh-TW.md): 選擇性開啟的加密儲存、金鑰保管、清除 - [容量與生命週期](docs/plugin/capacity.zh-TW.md): 預算、session 上限、保留 - [唯讀 env 查詢](docs/plugin/env-queries.zh-TW.md): 選擇性開啟、不回傳 value 的設定查詢工具 #### 持久化風險須知（開啟前必讀） 映射持久化需選擇性開啟，見[映射持久化](docs/plugin/persistence.zh-TW.md)。 - 設計為雙秘密——單獨拿到 DB 檔或金鑰都解不開，兩者同時才行。 - 備份（Time Machine、雲端同步）會複製 `SGP.db`：`forget` 無法回收備份已抄走的內容，還原備份＋尚存的金鑰可再識別舊 session——備份保留政策請一併考量。 - keychain 防**離線竊取**（偷磁碟、偷備份、複製 `SGP.db`）；不防已在你登入 session 內執行的惡意程式。 - keyfile 選項把門檻降為「同目錄樹的兩個檔案」，僅建議無 keychain 服務的伺服器/無頭環境使用。 **僅限 OpenCode v2 — Email 去識別化試驗：** 選擇性開啟的 `deidentify` 選項（必須搭配 `mode: "redact"`）會將重複出現的 MEDIUM 等級 email 命中改為穩定且不透明的 `[SG-EMAIL-…]` 佔位符，讓 agent 能關聯多筆記錄而不會看到原始地址。對應金鑰在每次 plugin setup（即一個 OpenCode session）產生一次、僅存在記憶體、永不持久化——佔位符在同一個 live session 內穩定，重新啟動後即改變，且不存在反查映射。其他行為維持不變：HIGH 憑證仍會被脫敏或攔截，截斷、編碼或無法驗證的內容會攔截整個單元。 ```jsonc { "package": "/絕對路徑/leakshield/dist", "options": { "mode": "redact", "deidentify": true } } ``` 附件：transparent 模式支援 `attachments` 政策（複數；`attachment` 不會被辨識）。**`"block"`（預設）** 會在 content hooks 略過 media／file parts 並以通知文字取代，模型讀不到這些被略過的圖片。Final wire 保護也會拒絕 wire 上殘留的附件 part；hook-first 不檢查後續才加入的附件。**`"allow"`** 會將附件未掃描送出並附加一則可見通知——這是明確的決定，代表你為附件內容作保（`"allow"` 需搭配 `mode: "transparent"`）。block／redact 模式下附件照舊攔截。既有對話可能重播原文，受[重啟限制](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md#重啟限制)影響；開新對話不能取代驗證復原。此 plugin 僅保護 OpenCode 發出的模型請求，不涵蓋其他 AI client 或本機工具。 OpenCode 目前會記錄並跳過在 plugin factory 執行前就載入失敗的模組，例如套件缺失或 JavaScript 語法錯誤。安裝或升級後，請先用 `sk-` 加至少 20 個英數字元的合成測試 key 執行 smoke test，確認訊息已被 LeakShield 替換，再處理真實機敏資料。 #### 隔離 smoke
